source_caption:
📺 The Big Bang Theory (2007–2019)

The Big Bang Theory follows Leonard Hofstadter and Sheldon Cooper, two brilliant physicists whose extraordinary intelligence often contrasts with their awkward social skills. Living together in Pasadena, California, the roommates spend their days discussing science, comic books, video games, and their favorite television shows alongside their equally nerdy friends Howard Wolowitz and Raj Koothrappali. Their predictable lives take an unexpected turn when Penny, a friendly aspiring actress, moves into the apartment across the hall. As friendships develop and romantic relationships become more complicated, the group experiences hilarious misunderstandings, awkward dates, career challenges, and unforgettable adventures. With the addition of Amy Farrah Fowler and Bernadette Rostenkowski, their lives become even more entertaining. Combining clever humor, memorable characters, and heartwarming moments, the series explores friendship, love, science, and the challenges of navigating everyday life.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Sitcom • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~22 minutes per episode • 12 seasons • 279 episodes

🎥 Creators: Chuck Lorre and Bill Prady

🏆 Recognition: Starring Jim Parsons, Johnny Galecki, Kaley Cuoco, Simon Helberg, and Kunal Nayyar, the series won 10 Primetime Emmy Awards. Jim Parsons received four Emmy Awards for his portrayal of Sheldon Cooper. The show became one of television’s most successful sitcoms and inspired the spin-off Young Sheldon.

📺 Where to Watch: Check HBO Max, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Big Bang Theory is an American television sitcom created by Chuck Lorre and Bill Prady for CBS. It aired from September 24, 2007, to May 16, 2019, running for 12 seasons and 279 episodes. The show originally centered on five characters living in Pasadena, California: Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), both physicists at the California Institute of Technology, who share an apartment; Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a waitress and aspiring actress who lives across the hall; and Leonard and Sheldon's similarly geeky and socially awkward friends and coworkers, aerospace engineer Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and astrophysicist Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar).
